pose: A massive, paddle-shaped scapula. The bone is enormous and widens at the top.
visual_hook: The 'Boat Oar'. This bone is taller than a human. It has a huge, rounded end to anchor the massive muscles needed to walk.
material: Matte, light-grey tan bone. Stony and deeply pitted.
inset_view: Top-right corner: Cross-section showing 'Lace-bone' pneumaticity—large open chambers within the thick bone.
